Description: Before you stands a rare bloom: the single white rose of Wutai─the one and only Yuffie! Summon your wind-up Yuffie minion.
DescriptionEnhanced: Legends tell of a sprightly shinobi maiden who wielded an enormous shuriken. A materia hunter by trade, she was not above stealing in order to acquire her prize, yet what she desired above all was to restore her nation to its former glory. You now have the honor of serving her mammet likeness.
Tooltip:
It has been far too long since
I shared a shadow with a shinobi.
   - Thancred
SpecialActionDescription: Triggers an enemy trap as if it were your own. If the trap deals physical damage, then potency is increased by 150%.

Description: Summon your lite-loader minion. Can move huge loads, a little at a time.
DescriptionEnhanced: This meticulously handcrafted toy is inspired by the warp loader developed for use in the Cosmic Exploration Initiative. Like the popular model suit, it was produced by the engineers of Garlond Ironworks, and is intended to form part of a collectable series of interstellar construction vehicles.
Tooltip:
These spongoi don't stand a chance
against a warp loader going full throttle!
   - Cosmic Exploration Initiative Member
SpecialActionDescription: Delivers an attack with a potency of 300 to all enemies within range. The action party is immediately withdrawn from the playing field after execution.

Description: Summon your budvi minion. A bud, buddy, and Nagylvi rolled into one.
DescriptionEnhanced: This diminutive relic of the Nagylvi was brought forth by their knowledge construct, which had awakened with the reactivation of Auxesia's city systems. First introduced simply as a “terminal,” it was given its present name following consultation with Namingway, in the hope that it will see you through on your journeys.
Tooltip:
Not only the “budvi,” but the forest,
the city...all of it is joined at the roots.
   - Mumukko
SpecialActionDescription:
Changes action party auto-attacks to area of effect attacks.
**Duration:** 12s
